$schema_note: Calibration of the CC client-version marker for capture analysis. Consumers (fleet canary, audit) MUST read this file instead of recoding the correspondence as a heuristic. Ground truth per request: the 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=' line (sits after messages, deep in the req file); system length is the cheap head-side proxy.
provenance: jsboige/claudish issue #102, comments of 2026-09-14 (three same-lane control pairs across CoursIA/roo-extensions/Argumentum/Epita-IS; ramp dated minute-by-minute 12/09)
caveats: A CC process keeps its version until restart: a session crossing a deployment keeps its old harness.
Ranges are calibrated on ai-01 5-lane traffic (fr-FR instructions); re-anchor if the fleet prompt language changes.
Ambiguous lengths (outside both ranges) fall back to the authoritative billing-header line.
